acceptance_predicates.description: Only an exact verified project-local cli2key receipt can produce the runtime sidecar authority.
Invocation key bytes and OAuth material never cross the runtime authority boundary or enter evidence.
The runtime issues an opaque live attempt consumable by the Codex adapter for one run or bounded sweep.
Substitution, stale identity, malformed readiness, crash, timeout, cancellation, and cleanup failures are typed and fail closed.
cli2key failures never fall back to OpenRouter, API keys, replay, or another provider.

definition_of_done: Runtime seam and public fake tests are merged with exact-head CI and post-merge evidence.

gates.description: Focused fake and hostile lifecycle matrix passes.
Protected merge and post-merge workflows are green.
